hypothesis: Train a diffusion model to detect and replace fabricated text tokens with verified ones, reducing hallucinations and improving AI safety.
description: The model uses a diffusion process to iteratively refine text while incorporating a safety classifier that flags likely hallucinations; by conditioning generation on this feedback, it reduces the likelihood of plausible-sounding but false statements, offering a mechanism to enhance trustworthiness without requiring external verification systems.
raw:
Hypothesis: A diffusion model is trained to suppress hallucinated content in text by learning to detect and replace fabricated tokens with verified alternatives, addressing the problem of unreliable AI outputs to improve safety.

Description: The model uses a diffusion process to iteratively refine text while incorporating a safety classifier that flags likely hallucinations; by conditioning generation on this feedback, it reduces the likelihood of plausible-sounding but false statements, offering a mechanism to enhance trustworthiness without requiring external verification systems.
